coreCollectionExclusionReason: This is a valid home-trades backup, but the curated three-reference home-services slot uses Fixwell, roofing and landscaping for source and structural variety.

source.name: Spicer Designs Plumbing website template
source.rightsEvidence: The downloaded HTML template is released under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Its retained README states the hero artwork is AI-generated placeholder art. The full license is stored beside this manifest.

provenance.capture: Local render of the official HTML template at 1440x1000 and 390x844; no layout, source copy, or source artwork was changed.
provenance.attribution: Spicer Designs, CC BY 4.0. Source attribution remains in the captured page footer and is recorded here.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A deep-navy/cyan plumbing service page with a compact dispatcher strip, a split hero pairing emergency copy and an ETA/flat-rate console, three distinct self-routing options, a filterable price table, a concise flat-rate explanation, a response-zone visualization, direct non-accordion FAQs, and a two-column contact close. The hero image is AI-generated placeholder artwork.

heroGeometry.mode: emergency promise beside a dispatch-console instrument
heroGeometry.alignment: left copy column and right console panel in a dark split composition
heroGeometry.viewport: phone and same-day next step visible in the first 1536x864 viewport

navigationGeometry.placement: small contact strip above direct service links
navigationGeometry.mobile: brand and phone remain visible; menu is brief and non-sticky

typography.scale: short high-impact headline, small data labels, readable dense rate rows

imageTreatment.mode: low-light pipe-room atmosphere with embedded service console
imageTreatment.crop: horizontal background with strong navy overlay
imageTreatment.focalPoint: service instrument and pipe detail; no people or signage

servicePresentation.pattern: emergency triage followed by a filterable flat-rate service table
servicePresentation.interaction: three visitor paths and service-category filters

ctaPlacement.primary: same-day service action beside the hero console

motion.reducedMotion: stable console status and complete rate table

rules: place emergency copy and phone action before console
convert the table to labeled service rows
remove map motion and prevent horizontal overflow

prohibitedPatterns: copied source name or demo claims

requiredSignatureElements.description: hero console for ETA and confirmed price context
clear urgent, scheduled, and unsure paths
filterable list of service scope, time, and price token fields
service-area visual that must be backed by client-provided location data

acceptanceChecks: urgent visitors can locate the phone action immediately
planned jobs can compare scoped service rows
price and ETA values remain sealed tokens
desktop hero fits at 100 percent zoom
mobile rate list remains readable without lateral scrolling

review.scope: source license, asset provenance, paired captures, and transferable design mechanics
